thread:
dina: Heads-up — planning a soft unpin of runtime v2.18 for hosted canaries next Wed 02:00 UTC. Phased traffic shift: 5% -> 25% -> 100% across multi-tenant pools. Deploy-bot scheduled the job. Deadman switch + rollback thresholds included. :eyes:

deploy-bot: scheduled job runtime-unpin-v2.18 at 2025-04-02T02:00:00Z id=job-82f3. Phases: 10m waits between steps, auto-rollback if thresholds breached.

ben: Quick Q — SDK compat? Do we need to pin any legacy SDK clients (sdk-1.x) to older runtime?

alice: Ben — yes, sdk-legacy still talks to runtime but there was a codec change for streaming headers in 2.18. Best to ensure we don't route sdk-legacy traffic to 2.18 in phase1. I'll add an explicit route rule.

maria: Telemetry note: set these deadman thresholds before start:
```
5xx_rate > 0.75% sustained over 2m -> rollback
p99_latency +200ms vs baseline -> rollback
per-tenant error spike > 3x baseline -> alert
```
I'll wire up alerts to #incidents and the oncall pager.

sre-josh: I'll add the rollback hook in deploy-bot runbook. Auto-rollback command is `/deploy abort job-82f3` and it will revert routing. Also adding a manual-step for canary approval to allow quick abort.

ben: Another concern: KV cache layout tweak in 2.18. Long-sequence models can observe corruption if runtime mismatch occurs. I'd recommend pinning longseq variants for phases 1-2.

alice: Agreed. I'll add entries to the pinlist for `model:llama3-longseq:v1` -> runtime=2.17 for phase1/2. We'll remove after phase3/48h if stable.

dina: Good call. Also recommend denylist for tenants known to use >2k token sequences in prod for phase1. Keep them on pinned runtime until phase2/3.

maria: I'll export per-tenant longseq metrics and push denylist to deploy config. Dashboard will show per-tenant 5xx and p99.

sre-josh: Ran stress harness yesterday; no regressions on short sequences, but reproduced a decaying token error at scale for long sequences. That's consistent with Ben's note. Denylist + pinlist seems necessary.

alice: Drafting customer-facing release note: "Planned runtime update (v2.17 -> v2.18) for hosted canaries on 2025-04-02 UTC. Customers using long-sequence models may be served by a pinned runtime for initial 48h. Contact support for exceptions." Will post to #customer-notify for review.

ben: For internal release notes, include the mitigation commands and exact pinlist entries. Example rollback snippet:
```
# rollback
/deploy abort job-82f3
# force-route pinned-runtime for tenant
route set tenant=tenant-123 runtime=2.17 --until=2025-04-04T02:00:00Z
```
deploy-bot: job update: phase=1 starting -> shifting 5% traffic now. watch windows enabled.

maria: Added dashboards and wired alerts. Also set a temporary 10m extended retention on logs for the canary window.

dina: Oncall owners: @sre-josh will own the rollback; @maria owns telemetry; @alice owns customer comms; @ben owns compatibility mapping. Please ack ownership.

sre-josh: Ack. I'll be in the runbook channel during rollout.

maria: Ack.

alice: Ack. Draft will be posted in 30m.

ben: Ack. I'll push the pinlist PR and link it here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: phase=1 complete -> holding 10m. No auto-rollback triggered. Next shift -> 25% in 10m.

dina: If anything looks off, hit the abort command and we'll roll back. Otherwise we'll proceed to phase2. Thanks team."
